hints.title: Common Prefix and Suffix Match
hints.text: Inserting an arbitrary sentence in the middle means one sentence matches the prefix and suffix of the other.

hints.title: Word List Two-End Matching
hints.text: Split both sentences into words, then greedily match equal words from the left and right ends.

hints.title: Covering Shorter Sentence
hints.text: If prefix matches plus suffix matches account for all words of the shorter sentence, the sentences are similar.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible substring insertions takes exponential string matching operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual boundary scanning matches prefix and suffix words linearly in O(n + m) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly ensures matching words from ends do not overlap.
